about: This prayer asks for a blessing over the offerings. The blessing is to bring both sanctification and joy at the feast of the saints.

s01.translation: Lord, we pray: may an abundant blessing descend upon these offerings. May it mercifully sanctify us and fill us with joy at the feast of the saints. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

alignments.gloss: gladden us at the feast of the saints
who lives and reigns with You

w002.explanation: This points to the offerings before the priest.

w009.explanation: The blessing is the subject of both verbs. It is asked to sanctify us and give us joy.

w012.explanation: The blessing is asked to bring sanctification to us.

w017.explanation: These are the saints whose feast is celebrated.

w018.explanation: The same praying community asks to be sanctified and made joyful.

w037.explanation: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
